(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more polyisocyanates modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid, wherein the polyisocyanates are derived from at least one aliphatic diisocyanate.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two distinct OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one polyisocyanate modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid based on an aliphatic diisocyanate.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The coating of claim 7, wherein the surface roughness of the coating is greater than 200 nm measured as root mean square roughness (Rq).
